text: Been waiting ages for someone to get back to me. I'm a childminder, boy 12 months, temp went up to 39.6 this evening. He's got a rash on his body but I've done the glass test and it goes pale when you press, so not that. In between his doses of ibuprofen he's crawling round, drinking his milk, babbling at me, totally himself. There's a bruise on his shin but he went over on the slide at the park this morning and I watched it happen. Mum wants to know if he needs seeing tonight or not. Would appreciate an answer sometime this side of midnight.
